simplification.note: Z-Anatomy already uses reduced BodyParts3D meshes. 125 structures that were still heavier than the smooth-rotation cap were simplified again with quadric decimation, which keeps the overall shape and the original name. Triangle count went from 1,241,090 to 314,234.

omitted: The pleural sheet was left out because it is one wrapping surface that would cover the lung lobes and hide them from a tap.
Bronchial branches inside the lungs were left out so a tap on the chest hits the lung lobe surface rather than an airway inside it.
Hair and nails were left out of the skin layer.
Tiny internal heart muscles (papillary muscles) and small cardiac vessels were left out so the heart chambers stay readable.
